messages:
sara_cs: FYI VerdantAI onboarding trending: token cost up 40% week-over-week and p95 latency jumped ~1.8x after model bump. Renewal Q3 noted as medium-risk. Any ops/quick mitigations we can offer before AE call?

alex_eng: @sara_cs can you pull the distribution of prompt lengths and percent of requests hitting >2k tokens?

sara_cs: Mostly short form FAQ flows (100-600 tokens) + a minority of long analytic prompts. Long ones are only ~8% traffic but dominate cost. Link to traffic slice: https://rwd.io/insights/verdantai-deck

rachel_ml: Two suggestions: 1) route short FAQ flows to a compact-int4 candidate, 2) offload long analytics to a batched, time-windowed async pipeline with slower model but low-cost.

alex_eng: Agreed. Compact-int4 for <700 tokens is a low-risk step. We should run the prompt-set eval (n=150) for ROUGE/BLEU and some human checks.

sara_cs: Customer cares about answer consistency for KB answers. We must ensure no hallucination regression.

rachel_ml: We'll run evals and add a synthetic subset for KB QA. Also recommend prefix KV caching for the system prompt and improve cache hit ratio.

devops: I can add a token-aware routing rule in Console. Sample rule to add to ops playbook:
```json
{
  "route": "account:verdantai",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "prompt_tokens <= 700", "model": "rw-compact-v2-int4"},
    {"if": "700 < prompt_tokens <= 4000", "model": "rw-large-v2-quant"},
    {"else": "rw-analytic-slow"}
  ],
  "fallback": "rw-large-v2"
}
```
(We default to large if anything fails).

alex_eng: I'd run a 5% canary first and collect p50/p95/p99 and token-error-rate. Can we tag the requests by intent so routing doesn't misclassify analytic prompts?

sara_cs: I'll ask VerdantAI to flag the analytic route with metadata: intent=analytics for 24h so we can verify. AE on the thread is OK with a short canary.

rachel_ml: Cost estimate: compact-int4 for short flows should cut unit cost by ~50% for that slice. Overall cost reduction depends on traffic split; if 70% short, expect ~35% total.

devops: Also recommend enabling continuous KV caching and lowering batch_size on dedicated pool during peak for smaller latencies; set batch_size=6 for the canary.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary scheduled for account:verdantai canary_id=canary-7141599999 at 7141600025. Monitoring p95/p99 and regen-quality checks.

sara_cs: Action items: 1) Rachel run prompt-set eval + KB regressions (ETA: 24h). 2) Devops deploy routing rule as 5% canary (ETA: next maintenance window). 3) Sara to update renewal-risk and notify AE. Will capture customer feedback after canary.

alex_eng: If evals pass, we can widen to 30% and enable async batching for analytics with a retry/notification pattern in 1 week.

sara_cs: Thanks team — will coordinate timing with VerdantAI and post results here. :thumbsup:
